title: 第9章 请宝贝转身第10章 市场经济无形大手
slug: 西游平账大圣在我贪亿点咋了
content_zh:
此刻恰逢月兔东升，苏元趁着夜色架云向北，一路疾驰，
越向北行，周遭越发阴森，
尤其远离天庭结节后，罡风更劲，刮得人元神都似要冻结。
这天外天的风非同小可，乃是三灾五劫中之赑风，最是伤人根本。
行了半夜，这才缓缓见到一座高耸建筑。
其形若刀，伫立在云海中。
正是天庭人人讳莫如深的所在——斩仙台。
此刻门前早已肃立着两名黑衣人，
苏元压下云头，默不作声地掏出一块非金非木的黑色腰牌递过去。
其中一人查验无误，递过来一件同样材质的宽大罩袍。
苏元不敢多言，迅速披上罩袍，遮住面容，闪身而入。
与斩仙台外部的肃杀凄冷截然不同。
斩仙台结界内，两排摊位井然有序，
虽然光线依旧昏暗，此刻却人声熙攘，影影绰绰，自成一方诡异世界。
只见左侧一个摊位上挂着一枚传声玉符，不断播放叫卖。
“六千年当季蟠桃，嘎嘎甜，不甜不要钱。”
再往里的摊位上挂着横七竖八各种横幅。
“金丹大甩卖，全场两百万，全场两百万！”
“正宗五庄观人参果，人人都吃，我吃两颗。”
“工坊倒闭！

炼器师傅跟凡人跑了，所有法宝清仓处理！”
排队人最多的摊位侧面立着一块木牌，
“广寒宫润人中介：专业提供子嗣偷渡上天服务，可落天河水军户籍，价格公道！
帮您一家团聚。”
苏元对眼前光怪陆离的景象早已见怪不怪。
这里便是近两千年来刚兴起的黑市。
天庭联通三界的通道只有三条。
南天门外那条，专司公职往来；
飞升登记处那条，迎接新晋仙人；
最后便是这斩仙台，专司处置贬谪之仙。
偏偏就有人能钻通空子，
将这肃杀之地变成了聚宝盆。
苏元熟门熟路地在拥挤的人流中穿行，
脑海中却还在思索赚钱法门。
项目工地上就别想了。
那里的钱早就被他搜刮到五百年后了，
项目部上各个都成了穷鬼，榨不出油水。
想短时间内搞到巨款，唯有来这黑市碰碰运气。
正思忖间，一个探头探脑、举止畏缩的身影闯入了他的视线。
content_en:
At this moment, the Moon Rabbit was rising in the east. Su Yuan took advantage of the darkness of night to fly northward, speeding all the way.
The further north you go, the darker your surroundings become.
Especially after we were far away from the Heavenly Nodule, the strong wind became even stronger, making people's spirits seem to freeze.
The wind outside the sky is no small matter. It is the most dangerous wind among the three disasters and five tribulations, and it is the most harmful to people.
After walking for half the night, we slowly saw a tall building.
It is shaped like a knife, standing in the sea of ​​clouds.
It is the place that everyone in heaven keeps secret - Immortal Killing Platform.
At this moment, two men in black were already standing in front of the door.
Su Yuan lowered his head and silently took out a black waistband that was neither gold nor wood and handed it over.
One of them checked it was correct and handed over a large burqa made of the same material.
Su Yuan did not dare to say anything, quickly put on his burqa, covered his face, and stepped in.
It is completely different from the chilling and cold atmosphere outside Zhanxiantai.
Within the boundary of Zhanxiandai, the two rows of stalls are in good order.
Although the light is still dim, there are crowds of people and shadows at this moment, forming a strange world of its own.
I saw a sound transmission jade talisman hanging on a stall on the left, which was constantly playing and selling.
"The flat peaches that have been in season for six thousand years are so sweet. If they are not sweet, they cost no money."
The stalls further inside were hung with various banners.
"Golden elixir sale, two million for the whole audience, two million for the whole audience!"
"Everyone eats the authentic Wuzhuang Guan ginseng fruit. I ate two."
“The workshop is closed down!
The weapon-refining master ran away with a mortal, and all the magic weapons were cleared! "
The stall with the most people queuing up has a wooden sign on the side.
"Guanghan Palace Runren Agency: Professionally provides services for children to be smuggled to heaven, and can be registered as a navy in the Tianhe River. The price is reasonable!
Help your family reunite. "
Su Yuan was already accustomed to the bizarre sight in front of him.
This is the black market that has just emerged in the past two thousand years.
There are only three passages from heaven to the three realms.
The one outside Nantianmen is dedicated to official business;
The one at the Ascension Registration Office to welcome new immortals;
Finally, there is the Immortal Killing Platform, which is responsible for dealing with demoted immortals.
It just so happens that there are people who can get through the loopholes.
Turn this chilling place into a cornucopia.
Su Yuanshu walked through the crowded crowd with familiarity.
But he was still thinking about ways to make money in his mind.
Forget about it on the project site.
The money there had already been plundered by him five hundred years later.
Everyone in the project department has become a poor man, unable to squeeze out any profit.
If you want to get a huge sum of money in a short time, you can only try your luck in this black market.
While he was thinking about it, a figure with a timid manner broke into his sight.
